question: Which of the following two quantities have the same dimensions?

options.text: Power and radius of circular motion

solution:
The correct answer is __**Work and torque**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Work and torque** have the same dimensions, which is energy or force times distance.
 
• The dimension of work is given by M¹L²T⁻².
 
• The dimension of torque is also M¹L²T⁻².
 
• Both quantities are measured in Joules (in SI units) or New
